# S46 — ork daemon stop and restart, and doctor flags a stale daemon

Seen 2026-10-20: the S29 run on a daemon started before S23 ran old code, with no sign of it. ork has no daemon stop or restart, and ork doctor does not compare the daemon's build with the CLI's. The owner had to kill the process by pid. Decided #102 (daemon.build-id): a build is identified by vcs.revision plus vcs.modified from runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo, falling back to the version var (cmd/ork/main.go:29).
